desc: Derive the exact transformation of four consecutive sorted coordinates and show that the three corresponding gaps transform as \((p,q,r)\to(r,q,p)\).
Characterize reachability: operations generate arbitrary permutations independently among odd-indexed gaps and even-indexed gaps.
Express the coordinate sum as \(N X_1+\sum_{j=1}^{N-1}(N-j)g_j\), apply rearrangement inequality within each parity class, and implement the minimum in \(O(N\log N)\).
Verify the final Python solution against both samples and boundary configurations, using integer arithmetic only.
